description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330015538163 SPACER,RING,AIRCRAF: Line 0001 Qty 43 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0055 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
